records.reference_answer: Under NHDP Infrastructure & Technology Support (URBAN HAAT), per-unit assistance is ₹8 crore, split 40% each by O/o DC(HC) and DC(HL) and 20% plus land by the implementing agency (45%/45%/10% in NER, J&K, Ladakh, A&N, and Lakshadweep). records.vanilla_answer: Under the National Handicrafts Development Programme, the per-unit funding ceiling for setting up an URBAN HAAT is ₹15 lakh. The funding is split as 60% from the Central Government and 40% from the State Government.

records.question: Which types of organizations are eligible to conduct craft sector surveys and studies under the NHDP Research & Development Scheme?
